used_propositions: CRM record HEL-441 corresponds to the account name Helion Robotics Ltd.
Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM, while invoices use Helion Robotics Limited, and these are the same legal entity.
Invoices bill under the name Helion Robotics Limited.
support_claim: CRM record HEL-441 is grounded to Helion Robotics Ltd, commercial notes establish that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, and billing records confirm the right referent as that billed name.
